description: The Warp app, Open WebUI Desktop and Open WebUI from PyPI on Windows, installed and not run.
why: Warp's witness is the Uninstall key its app installer writes, since nothing from its Agent CLI is installed here. Open WebUI has two: the desktop app's Uninstall key and the uv tool directory, which require_rows holds. cursor and windsurf are forbidden because their Uninstall keys are read by the same branch, and aider because its uv tool directory is too.
known_gaps: Open WebUI's Docker image is read on Linux only, in 79-linux-image; the Windows runner has no Linux container daemon.
Warp's installer starts the app and setup stops it at once, and Open WebUI Desktop is never launched, so neither is proved running and what a full first run writes is not read.
